agent.finish_summary: Fixed a regression in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py's group_period() post() callback: the ternary that decides whether the grouped Identifier should extend to include the token after the period token had its True/False branches swapped (`(pidx, tidx) if valid_next else (pidx, nidx)` instead of the correct `(pidx, nidx) if valid_next else (pidx, tidx)`). This caused constructs like `a.*` to greedily absorb the following comma-separated identifier (e.g. `select a.*, b` became a single malformed Identifier instead of an IdentifierList with two items), breaking wildcard detection, JSON operator grouping, and reindent/right-margin formatting across many tests. Restored the correct branch order and verified via manual parse/format checks on wildcard, plain dotted, JSON arrow (->, ->>), and multi-column identifier-list SQL, all of which now produce correct token trees and reindented output.
